# AXIOM-MESH

> AXIOM-MESH is a local-first coordination, authority, and evidence substrate for human and machine agents. Its core invariant is that capability, discovery, connectivity, and possession of credentials do not create authority on their own. Current supported build: 0.12.0-dev.3, production candidate, not production-promoted.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Zoverions/AXIOM-MESH/blob/main/README.md): supported build, architecture, claims, non-claims, setup, and verification.
- [Agent entry](https://github.com/Zoverions/AXIOM-MESH/blob/main/AGENT-ENTRY.md): shortest agent-facing explanation of capability versus authority.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/Zoverions/AXIOM-MESH/blob/main/.cursorrules): installation, configuration, usage, contribution authority, and machine-facing operating rules.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Zoverions/AXIOM-MESH/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution and repository-effect boundaries.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/Zoverions/AXIOM-MESH/blob/main/SECURITY.md): disclosure and security-reporting process.
